alate: Head capsule dark brown with a reddish tinge, postmentum concolorous with the head capsule; antennae, labrum and postclypeus brown; compound eyes greyish black, eye ring and ocelli pale brownish yellow; pronotum dark brown; wings pale yellowish brown; femora brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellowish brown. Head capsule elongate-oval, fontanelle dot-like, 0.39–0.41 mm from the frontal margin; in profile the vertex arched, the postclypeus slightly projecting and lower than the vertex. Compound eyes rounded-triangular, larger than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head, protrusion 7–8%. Short diameter of the ocellus more than twice the ocellus–compound eye distance. Postclypeus about 5 times as wide as long, the median suture visible. Pronotum 1.36–1.40 times as wide as long, anterior margin broadly incised, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly, posterior margin shallowly notched in the middle.
biology: Specimens collected from the roots of Pinus massoniana.
distribution: Longquan, Zhejiang (altitude 1050 m); also recorded elsewhere in the province.
soldier: Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60, lateral margins nearly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin broadly rounded. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between them. Labrum ligulate, apex narrow and rounded, apical setae present, subapical setae minute. Mandibles slender, apex slightly curved; mandible length 0.60 times head capsule length and 1.02 times head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Broad region of the postmentum before the anterior quarter, waist constriction index 0.34. Pronotum 1.44 times as wide as long, the incisions at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both rather distinct, lateral margins gently sloping posteriorly; about 20 setae in the middle region.
